title: NFL WEEK 8 BETS: Panthers-Packers, Ravens-Bills, Browns-Steelers, Vikings-Lions, Chiefs-Broncos
transcript_summary: Chad Millman and Simon Hunter preview the NFL Week 8 betting slate on Sharp or Square, reviewing contest standings before analyzing key matchups including Panthers at Packers, Vikings at Lions, Browns at Steelers, and Eagles at Commanders.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Welcome to Sharp or Square presented by Polymarket, part of The Volume podcast network. I am Chad Millman, joined as always by my BFF, co-host, professional bettor Simon Hunter.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Chad, how are we doing?

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: We are off a second straight 4-1 week in the contest, standing at 18-17 overall and in 123rd place out of 6,000 entrants.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Let's keep it going, buddy.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Thursday Night Football: Panthers at Packers (-3.5). I am locking in Carolina Panthers +3.5 as Chad's Choice.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Don't hate it. The spot favors Carolina coming off a buy-low situation with Green Bay laying 3.5 on a short week.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Raiders (-0.5) at Jets. The line flipped from Raiders favorite to Jets.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: I'm looking at the Jets side here, taking the points with New York.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Cardinals at Cowboys (-6.5). Arizona keeps games competitive.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Agreed, Cardinals +6.5 is a position to take against an overvalued Cowboys squad.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Vikings at Lions (-3.5). What is Simon Says this week?

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Simon Says: give me Minnesota Vikings +3.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Falcons at Bucs (-2.5). The market is moving towards Tampa Bay despite public tickets on Atlanta.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Browns at Steelers (-3.5). The Browns line is inflated given Pittsburgh coming back from Europe.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Colts at Jaguars (-7.5) and Ravens at Bills (-3.5). If Lamar plays, Baltimore +3.5 is the move.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Titans at Bengals (-10.5) and Chargers at Rams (-6.5). Chargers are technically the value side.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Patriots (-7.5) at Dolphins, Chiefs (-1.5) at Broncos, Eagles at Commanders (-4.5).

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Miami +7.5 is a huge number at home. The Eagles look lost and Washington is laying 4.5.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chad Millman
speaker_segments.text: Bears at Seahawks (-3.5) on Monday Night Football. We wrap up our Week 8 predictions.

speaker_segments.speaker: Simon Hunter
speaker_segments.text: Thanks for watching everybody, see you Thursday!

extracted_picks.speaker: Chad Millman
extracted_picks.rationale: Chad's Choice pick: Panthers +3.5 on Thursday night coming off a bounce-back spot facing an un-disciplined Green Bay squad on a short week.

extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Simon Says pick: Minnesota Vikings +3.5 against the Lions in a divisional matchup where Detroit is inflated by the public.

analysis_notes.summary: Chad and Simon break down Green Bay laying 3.5 on Thursday Night Football, pointing to Green Bay's penalty issues and Carolina's tendency to bounce back after blowout losses.
analysis_notes.speaker: Chad Millman
analysis_notes.quote: Bryce coming off a bad game is now a dog on the road against a defensive backfield that is susceptible to explosive plays.

analysis_notes.summary: The line flipped from Raiders as short favorites to Jets -0.5 as public and sharp money split on the matchup.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: I just always knew this was going to be a Jets side.

analysis_notes.topic: Vikings Blitz Scheme vs Jared Goff
analysis_notes.summary: Simon highlights Brian Flores' heavy blitz scheme as the key matchup advantage for Minnesota against Jared Goff, who struggles when pressured up the middle.
analysis_notes.speaker: Simon Hunter
analysis_notes.quote: What is Goff's weakness? Pressure up the middle, getting him off his spot.

analysis_notes.topic: Steelers Returning from Overseas without a Bye
analysis_notes.summary: Hosts analyze Pittsburgh playing without a bye week immediately following their London trip, making Cleveland +3.5 an attractive situational spot.
analysis_notes.speaker: Chad Millman
analysis_notes.quote: The Steelers coming back from Europe not taking the bye after a long travel week.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Simon Hunter
quote_timestamps.quote: Simon Says give me Minnesota Vikings +3.5.
